statements.subject: part
statements.description: Parts in messages and artifact responses use one of: text content, raw binary data (base64), or url file reference — as shown by: text part, raw+filename+mediaType part (upload), and url+filename+mediaType part (download reference).
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one of allowed_values must be present as the content-bearing field of a Part; becomes NuXMV INVAR not a per-transition guard

statements.subject: part
statements.description: A file upload part contains a raw field carrying base64-encoded binary content: { "raw": "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAUA..." }

statements.subject: part
statements.description: A file part (raw or url) may carry a filename field: "filename": "input_image.png" or "filename": "output.png"

statements.subject: part
statements.description: A file part (raw or url) may carry a mediaType field specifying the MIME type: "mediaType": "image/png"

statements.subject: part
statements.description: A file reference part contains a url field pointing to the downloadable resource: "url": "https://storage.example.com/processed/task-bbb/output.png?token=xyz"

statements.subject: artifact
statements.description: An artifact contains an artifactId field: "artifactId": "9b6934dd-37e3-4eb1-8766-962efaab63a1"

statements.subject: artifact
statements.description: An artifact may carry a name field providing a human-readable label: "name": "processed_image_with_faces.png"

statements.subject: artifact
statements.description: An artifact contains a parts array holding the output content parts: "parts": [{ "url": ..., "filename": ..., "mediaType": ... }]

statements.subject: task
statements.description: The task response for a file exchange includes an artifacts array: "artifacts": [{ "artifactId": ..., "name": ..., "parts": [...] }]

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Scenario: Client sends an image for analysis (POST /message:send with raw file Part), and the agent returns a task in TASK_STATE_COMPLETED with an artifact containing a URL-based Part referencing the modified output image.
statements.pre_cond: message.parts contains Part with text != null & message.parts contains Part with raw != null
statements.post_cond: task.status.state = TASK_STATE_COMPLETED & task.artifacts != null & task.artifacts[0].parts[0].url != null
actions: Client sends POST /message:send with message containing a text instruction Part and a raw binary file Part (base64-encoded image, filename, mediaType)
Server processes the uploaded file and performs the requested analysis
Server returns HTTP 200 with task object in TASK_STATE_COMPLETED
Server includes artifacts array with one Artifact containing a url Part referencing the processed output file
